title: Scalar orbit-completeness is equivalent to TPI
claim: For a fixed reference x, if the declared scalar distinction s_x is invariant under the stabilizer G_x, then saying that s_x completely separates G_x-orbits is equivalent to saying G_x is transitive on each s_x level set (TPI relative to s_x).
consequence: Operational completeness of the existing Euclidean scalar cannot independently derive TPI; it either fails, assumes TPI in equivalent language, or requires richer invariants that invalidate the scalar-only TPI inference.
next_target: Derive collapse of all stabilizer-invariant operational information to the PDT distinction scalar from independent composition/resource/calibration primitives, and stress it against unitary, symplectic and exceptional sphere actions.
